notes.subject: והביטו אחרי
notes.rationale: 'ba shebella' — seheberu 'ba lebelela ka morao' ho Moshe; Sesotho e hlalosa tshebetso e tshwanang

notes.subject: is
notes.rationale: Ha ho ya ekeditsweng — 'mong le mong a eme' ke morphological recapitulation ya 'איש', e leng teng sehberung

notes.subject: mosako-oahlwa
notes.rationale: 'mosako-oahlwa' — פתח ke 'mokgoa' kapa 'moaho-oahlwa' — entrara ya tenta, Sesotho e hloka mantswe a mabedi

notes.subject: האהל / האהלה
notes.rationale: sefela sa directive sa qetello (האהלה) — thoko e ikgethileng, thibela tlhaku-e le nngwe feela

translation: Mme ho ile ha etsahala hore, ha Moshe a tswa a ya teng-tenta, baetapele-botlhe ba ntsha — batho ohle ba ema, mong le mong a eme mosako-oahlwa wa tenta ya hae, mme ba shebella Moshe, ho fihlela a kena teng-tenta.

tokens.gloss: Mme ho ile ha etsahala hore
